day_line: Rain and mist on an Ox day. Calm and steady: good for slow chores and cosy plans, easy to stay in bed too long.

lines.Yang Wood: Someone helps without asking today. Accept the lift and skip the rain.
lines.Yin Wood: A rainy Saturday clears your head. Make a cup of tea and plan December.
lines.Yang Fire: Your helpfulness gets noticed today. Fix the family Wi-Fi and take a bow.
lines.Yin Fire: Saturday asks a lot of you. Do the errands in one loop, then rest.
lines.Yang Earth: Slow spending suits you today. Fix it, don't replace it.
lines.Yin Earth: A small win waits at the shops today. Check the clearance shelf first.
lines.Yang Metal: Your stories are good today. Tell the one that makes Grandma laugh.
lines.Yin Metal: Cosy fun suits you today. Film marathon, blanket, no guilt.
lines.Yang Water: Someone wants the sofa too. Share it, and share the snacks.
lines.Yin Water: Your favourite people are near today. Invite them over for steamboat.
